title: Field Engineering
description: Gravity, dimension, time and the vacuum are all fields - and fields can be projected. Unlocks the Field Projectors, the Graviton Harness and the Chronal Anchor.

puzzle.goal: A field projector must reproduce the gravitational field of an arbitrary mass distribution of density ρ filling a volume V. Add up the inverse-square pull of every mass element at source point s on a test point r, as a vector.
puzzle.name: Newtonian gravitational field of a mass distribution
puzzle.form: - G * iiint ( ρ * ( vec ( r ) - vec ( s ) ) / norm ( vec ( r ) - vec ( s ) ) ^ 3 , V )
puzzle.ask: Outside a spherical body the integral reduces to that of a point mass M. Find the field strength at the surface of the Earth.
puzzle.method: A mass element ρ dV at s pulls toward itself along the unit vector (s − r)/|r − s| with strength G ρ dV/|r − s|²; superpose all elements.
